name: Overnight drift (Globex session hold)
source: Lou, Polk & Skouras (2019), A tug of war: overnight versus intraday expected returns, JFE 134(1)
Boyarchenko, Larsen & Whelan (2023), The overnight drift, RFS 36(9): index-futures returns concentrate overnight around the European open and are larger after a down US session
market: MNQ (MES reported as a diagnostic only)

data.exam: 2025-01-01..2026-10-21 locked; only via the proctor, with Jason's OK

prop_fit: the position opens at the 17:00 CT Globex reopen and closes before the 08:30 RTH open: inside one CME/Topstep trading day (17:00-16:00 CT), flat long before the 15:10 CT cut-off

rule.session: for each NYSE session D in the calendar: the overnight that ends at D's 08:30 CT open (starts at the previous calendar evening's 17:00 CT reopen; Sunday's for Monday)
rule.entry: long 1 contract at the open of the 17:00 CT bar
rule.exit: at the open of the 08:29 CT bar of D (flat before the RTH open)
rule.stop: none (the account's own loss limits only)

trials.T2_after_down_day: trade only if the previous NYSE session's RTH return (close of the last bar before its regular close minus open of its 08:30 bar) is < 0; otherwise no trade ($0)

rule.missing: a missing entry or exit bar -> non-evaluable day; a calendar gap (holiday) between the evening and D -> skip ($0)

costs: L3 = Topstep fees + 4 ticks per round trip (MNQ 322 cents); L1-L4 reported
luck: matched control: the same entry and exit bars with a random direction (500 draws/day, numpy PCG64 seeded [20261029, root(MNQ=1,MES=2), yyyymmdd, 12]); daily control = mean of draws
diagnostics: always-long RTH (08:30 open -> 15:00 close) on the same sessions: where the drift lives
per-year results; MES on the same rule

gates.beats_luck: one-sided paired stationary bootstrap vs the matched control (workbench inference), at the family Sidak bar for 2 trials: alpha = 1 - 0.95^(1/2) = 0.0253 each
gates.floor: net >= $5.00/day at L3 averaged over all evaluable sessions (GRADING floor)
gates.sharpe: annual Sharpe of daily L3 net >= 1.0
gates.advance: a passing trial goes to the prop simulator (frozen menu) on practice data; exam check #2 only with Jason's OK
gates.no_retuning: no other parameters; failures are recorded as is

caveat_known_in_advance: a long-only hold also earns plain market beta; 2019-2024 Nasdaq rose. The random-direction control tests drift > 0, not skill. The RTH diagnostic shows whether the premium is specific to the overnight window.
honesty: 2 distinct workbench trials on MNQ (+ MES diagnostics, not gated)
